---
id: brown-kiwi
title: Brown kiwi
---
The North Island brown kiwi (*Apteryx mantelli*) is flightless, nocturnal,
and endemic to New Zealand. Nostrils sit at the bill tip; the bird sniffs
forest litter for invertebrates. Hair-like feathers hide tiny wings. Eggs
are huge relative to the hen. Introduced mammals are the main threat;
sanctuaries fence them out.
